shawn desman.bio: Mississauga-born singer, songwriter and dancer Shawn Desman is a major Canadian R&B and pop figure whose catalogue blends dance, hip-hop and electronic production with high-energy performance.

shawn hook.bio: British Columbia singer-songwriter Shawn Hook makes polished Canadian pop built around piano, emotionally direct songwriting and a career that spans recording, television composition and international touring.

shawnee kish.bio: Two-Spirit Mohawk singer-songwriter Shawnee Kish is an award-winning Canadian artist whose powerhouse vocals move through country, soul and rock with emotionally raw, identity-rooted storytelling.

shay lia.bio: Montréal-based singer-songwriter Shay Lia makes smooth, danceable alternative R&B, combining soulful vocals with club, Afro-pop and electronic influences and frequent collaboration with Kaytranada.

skratch bastid.bio: Bedford, Nova Scotia-born DJ and producer Skratch Bastid is a leading Canadian turntablist known for technically inventive sets, production work and a career bridging Halifax and Toronto hip-hop communities.

skydiggers.bio: Toronto roots-rock band Skydiggers, led by founding members Andy Maize and Josh Finlayson, has built a decades-long Canadian catalogue around harmony-rich songwriting, folk-rock and roots music.

skye sweetnam.bio: Bolton, Ontario singer-songwriter Skye Sweetnam emerged as a Canadian pop-rock artist in the 2000s before evolving into the alternative-metal frontwoman Sever with Sumo Cyco.

sloan.bio: Halifax-formed, Toronto-based rock band Sloan is a long-running Canadian power-pop institution distinguished by its unchanged four-member lineup and shared songwriting and lead-vocal duties.

shaun boothe.bio: Canadian rapper, speaker and educator Shaun Boothe uses hip-hop storytelling in music and his Unauthorized Biography Series, turning the lives of cultural figures into narrative rap performances.

shub.bio: Mohawk producer and turntablist Shub, formerly known as DJ Shub, is a Six Nations artist and former A Tribe Called Red member who helped pioneer the powwow-step sound.
